title: Books Finished vs Yearly Goal
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=book:finished
| bin _time span=1y
| stats count as books by _time
| eval goal=24, pct=round(100*books/goal,1)
| sort - _time
description: Counts the books you finish each year against your reading challenge, keeping the goal in sight.
value: A visible progress bar against a reading goal is a proven nudge to pick the book over the phone.
implementation: Ingest finished-book events into `index=personal`; track against a yearly goal.
visualization: Progress bar of books finished versus goal.
grandmaExplanation: It counts the books you finish each year against your goal, nudging you to keep reading.
